title: Explain and Conquer: Personalised Text-based Reviews to Achieve Transparency
reasoning: The paper focuses on explainability and transparency of recommender systems, aiming to improve user understanding and acceptance of recommendations. It does not contain a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The discussion on 'human suitability' relates to how well explanations align with user expectations, not ethical content or behavior generated by the model.
